sections.heading: Halaman 3
sections.content:
3
On
-
line Test Procedure
Partial Discharge Data Collection Using TGA
-
B
Purpose: To observe the PD that occurs in a machine during 
normal operations. This requires an Iris instrument and a laptop 
computer running 
PDLitePro
.
Safety Precautions
1.Power supply for the instrument must be connected through 
GFCI device.
2. The shield of the coaxial cable should be hard grounded at the 
termination box. The 50/60Hz AC voltage between the center pin 
and the shield of PDA and Bus installs should be 100
-
600mV AC. 
If the ground is disconnected it is possible that this voltage may 
float to a higher value, so always check before connecting cables. 
On
-
line Test Procedure
COLLECTION SET UP
1.Review previous partial discharge measurement and obtain 
database.
2.Verify database accuracy, instrument connection and 
instrument setup.
3.Run tester to make sure that the instrument is working 
correctly.

sections.heading: Halaman 4
sections.content:
4
On
-
line Test Procedure
PARTIAL DISCHARGE DATA COLLECTION
1.
Record machine operation parameters and input the data on 
Asset Information of 
PDlite
software.
2. Measure voltage (mV) across BNC connection. Record values 
and anomalies.
3. Connect input channel on the front of the IRIS instrument to 
which the sensors are connected.
On
-
line Test Procedure
4. Setup the Iris instrument mode for the test: use BUS mode test. 
Be sure when using Bus mode that you set the instrument to use a 
C1/Mach, or Machine reference.
5. Select the specific sensitivity to run the test, or you can choose 
to run a sequence test. A sequence will start at the highest range 
(500
-
8500 mV) and then when directed progressively decrease 
until stopped. 
The 2mV to 34mV and 5mV to 85mV ranges use an
amplifier; so only use these when the PD levels are within
these ranges to avoid damage to the Iris instrument.
6. Set the appropriate reference angle when a measurement is 
performed (90

) for EMC
.
7. Set appropriate delay time for correct measurement.

sections.heading: Halaman 5
sections.content:
5
On
-
line Test Procedure
8. Run measurement and observe the quality flags. 
•
Retest at higher sensitivity range if there is OVR flags. 
•
Retest at lower sensitivity range if there is UND flags.
9. Verify if there are any trend changes in the PD data.
10.Verify if PD in usual position (phase shift). 
11. Discussion and notes.
Basic Interpretation of PD Testing Results

Instrumentation provides:
1.
Pulse Height Analysis Plot (2D)
—
Qm for peak PD magnitude
—
NQN for total PD activity
2.
Pulse Phase Analysis Plot (3D)
3.
Leaner Density Plot (3D)

Three Basic Methods for Interpretation

Compare graphs from identical machine 
(stator with highest PD is most deteriorated)

Compare test result from a machine to a 
similar machines in Iris database

Trend PD over time (2 times increase per year 
is significant rate of deterioration)

13
Trend PD Over Time

Trending of data

Most powerful, reliable means of interpreting data

If Qm low, and constant trend, winding in good 
condition

Collect data over the years, if Qm increases slowly, 
winding is stable

If Qm doubles in 6 to 12 months, rate of deterioration 
increasing

Trending Can also determine if repairs effective
